interpretation: Five affected methods only: three Download-related matrices pass after GET redaction comparison. Both availability cases complete all four role/lifecycle variants with eight failed one-save repairs, rollback assertions and passing two-save controls. Final method failures are intentional catalog expectation failures, not incomplete cleanup.

PAPI-001.assertions: Course, Download, Consultation and Membership POSTs with a foreign Creator owner return 201 and persist the authenticated Creator as owner. Owner GET verifies identity, type, Draft/free defaults, EUR, one-time or recurring Month pricing. Four Products, no Admin audits.

PAPI-002.assertions: Admin creates all four types for a separate single-role Creator. Four 201 responses, owner GETs and exact management-list IDs match; four audit records have the Admin actor, Product ID/type, selected owner, creation action, timestamp and null before-summary.

PAPI-003.assertions: All four types × missing/null/blank/unknown/User/Admin/invalid-UUID owners are rejected. Unknown owner returns 404, malformed UUID 400, absent or wrong-role owner 403. No Product or audit persists after any of 28 attempts.

PAPI-004.assertions: User with valid CSRF is denied 403 for POST, full PUT, canonical PATCH/DELETE and legacy DELETE across all four types. Exact owner GET snapshots, Product counts and audit counts remain unchanged.

PAPI-005.assertions: Nonowner Creator PATCH, full PUT and canonical DELETE return 403 across all four types, with both actual-owner and forged-caller user IDs. Exact owner snapshots and Course/Download nested data remain; no audit or SDK operation. This completes API ownership checks only; external object-cleanup rollback remains a separate deployed investigation as the catalog specifies.

PAPI-007.assertions: Creator and Admin × Course/Download PATCH bodies forge another Product ID/type/owner and replacement sections. The path ID, existing type and actual owner remain authoritative; only requested shared name changes. Nested IDs/content, omitted description/price/status and the entire foreign Product remain unchanged. Owner GET verifies persisted fields; two Admin audits recorded. Mutation Download URLs are compared through the documented GET redaction, not mistaken for missing nested content.

PAPI-008.assertions: Creator/Admin full PUT returns 202. Course shared fields save while attempted empty nested details preserve lessons/sections. Download complete retained list updates the retained section and preserves its file ID, removes an omitted section; omitted details preserve the collection and explicit empty sections remove it and its local file metadata. Owner GET and persistence verify each step; ownership is unchanged. No external object deletion is inferred.

PAPI-012.assertions: Creator/Admin × Course/Consultation PATCH invalid status and nonnumeric price separately from Draft and Hidden. Existing semantic fields persist unchanged; creation with both invalid strings succeeds as Draft/free with type pricing defaults. API fallback is verified. The catalog requests investigation of intended client validation expectations; that policy remains unresolved.

PAPI-013.assertions: Creator/Admin Hidden Download with price 10: invalid status PATCH succeeds and persists Draft, preserving price. Separate nonnumeric price PATCH returns 400; subsequent owner GET exactly matches the preceding saved snapshot.

PAPI-016.assertions: Creator/Admin × Course/Download/Consultation × active purchase/live pending checkout/expired pending checkout: 18 fixtures. Purchases are created through fake payment completion; canonical and legacy deletion reject live guards with 409 and preserve Products, orders, grants and events. Hidden PATCH remains available. Expired pending checkout alone allows canonical 204 deletion; Product GET is 404 and immutable order item/financial snapshots remain readable. Disposable local commerce only.

PAPI-017.assertions: Creator/Admin × four types: initial canonical delete succeeds 204; repeated and random-unknown canonical and legacy deletions each return 404. A separate control Product and exact read snapshot remain unchanged; missing attempts create no further audit rows or removal.

PAPI-018.assertions: Creator/Admin × Draft/Hidden Course without sections returns 422 with exactly details.sections: At least one section is required. Full GET and persisted lifecycle stay unchanged. Adding the ready section/Article permits 200 Published, verified by owner GET and persistence.

PAPI-019.assertions: Creator/Admin × Draft/Hidden Course with one empty section returns 422 with exactly details.lessons: At least one lesson is required. Rejection preserves the full snapshot. Adding an Article to that section permits Published and persists it.

PAPI-020.assertions: Creator/Admin × Draft/Hidden × otherwise-ready Course/Download with negative price returns 422 with exactly price: Price must be free or positive. Full state is unchanged. Correcting only price to free allows Published and verified persisted GET.

PAPI-021.assertions: Creator/Admin × Draft/Hidden × null/blank file paths returns 422 with exactly details.files: At least one confirmed file is required. Snapshots remain unchanged. Supplying nonblank synthetic path metadata permits Published and persisted GET. This tests the publication metadata gate only; no object exists in Spaces and actual upload/delivery is not tested.

PAPI-022.assertions: Creator/Admin × Draft/Hidden, otherwise-ready Consultation with zero price returns 422 with only price: Consultations require a positive price. Rejection retains state; correcting price permits Published and persisted read.

PAPI-023.assertions: Creator/Admin × Draft/Hidden × zero/negative duration returns 422 with only details.durationMinutes: Duration must be positive. Rejection preserves state; correcting duration to 30 permits Published and persisted read.

PAPI-024.assertions: Creator/Admin × Draft/Hidden Consultation without meeting method returns 422 with only details.meetingMethod: Meeting method is required. State is preserved; adding Zoom permits Published and persisted read.

PAPI-025.assertions: Creator/Admin × Draft/Hidden Consultation with Other and blank location returns 422 with only details.customLocation: A custom location is required for OTHER. State is preserved; adding synthetic location instructions permits Published and persisted read.

PAPI-026.assertions: Creator/Admin × Draft/Hidden, all availability disabled: expected 422 weeklyAvailability rejection and unchanged state pass. Correcting existing Monday to enabled and requesting Published fails 400 with an availability-day uniqueness error in all four variants. Full rollback confirmed. Clearing availability in a separate save, then adding corrected Monday and publishing succeeds as a control. BUG-030; isolated current backend, deployed reproduction pending.

PAPI-027.assertions: Creator/Admin × Draft/Hidden, Monday 09–11 and 10–12: expected 422 overlap error and unchanged state pass. Replacing existing Monday with nonoverlapping 09–12 and requesting Published fails 400 with an availability-day uniqueness error in all four variants. Full rollback confirmed. Separate clear then corrected save publishes successfully. BUG-030; isolated current backend, deployed reproduction pending.
